Anya: CI alert — eval-runner reported a regression on leaderboard_small (pass@1 down ~8%) after the promptset canonicalizer PR merged. Anyone seen this?

eval-ci-bot: eval-ci: job eval/leaderboard_small failed on commit abc123 (author: mateo). Metric delta: pass@1 -8.2%. Changed: tools/prompt_canonicalizer.py, data/promptsets/v2/*.json

Mateo: repro'd locally. Looks like canonicalizer removed the suffix 'assistant.v2' from prompt tags (it normalizes punctuation). Our holdout selector uses exact tag matches so some samples that previously matched holdout tags no longer match → they got included in training. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:

Linh: ouch. which runner version did the eval use? we pushed a small change to tag matching yesterday, could be an interaction.

Mateo: runner v3.14. Local repro command and minimal diff:

```bash
# repro
python -m eval_runner --promptset data/promptsets/v2/leaderboard_small.json --model models/small_quant:v2 --run-id debug123
```

Example tag before canonicalizer:
```json
{"id": 1245, "text": "...", "tags": ["persona:assistant.v2", "task:math"]}
```
After canonicalizer:
```json
{"id": 1245, "text": "...", "tags": ["persona:assistant", "task:math"]}
```
So holdout filter `tag=="persona:assistant.v2"` is no longer selecting those rows.

Ravi: runner change note: we switched from exact== to startsWith for tag checks to speed up lookup — that plus canonicalizer stripping suffixes will definitely change set semantics. StartsWith was supposed to be a safe relaxation but not when code mutates the tag namespace.

Anya: proposed mitigations: 1) pin promptset commit in CI to pre-canonicalizer while we triage, 2) add a failing assertion in eval CI that checks holdout/train disjointness by id fingerprint, 3) revert canonicalizer on staging for now.

Mateo: created GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness/issues/948 — description + minimal repro + suggested CI change. Assigning to @Linh. I pushed a small CI patch that pins data/promptsets/v2 to commit def456 as a temporary guard.

Linh: taking it. Plan: add a canonical-tag fingerprint to promptset metadata (like tag_fingerprint: sha256 of sorted tags per-example) and a CI assert that compares holdout vs train fingerprint sets for intersection==0. Also adding unit test for runner holdout selector semantics covering exact vs startsWith.

eval-ci-bot: queued: rerun eval/leaderboard_small for commit abc123 (pending).

Anya: important to note — the quantized model v2 numbers also dipped slightly but that's a separate axis; we'll keep that in a different ticket so we don't conflate root causes. :memo:

Ravi: I'll add a Console dashboard alert for "prompt-tag-entropy spike" (new metric) and a per-promptset histogram of distinct tag counts so we catch normalization storms earlier. Query sketch: `count(distinct tags) by promptset, release`

Anya: agreement: add smoke check that samples 100 holdouts and asserts no id overlap with train using fingerprint equality. If CI fails, block merges and notify #eng-oncall.

Mateo: thanks — logging the short-term revert + CI pin in the issue. Will follow up with a lightweight migration plan for canonicalizer so it preserves tag namespaces used by holdouts. (reaction :eyes:)
